reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.body: These things suck. I was really disappointed considering I like my jbl speakers so much. Definitely won’t buy any more of their ear buds though.

reviews.title: Would not recommend unless you like to listen to static
reviews.body: Have an automatic ambient sound mode that can't be disabled. Sounds like extremely loud white noise/static that overpowers whatever you try to listen to. Apparently it's a default design feature that isn't advertised.
